name: schemesetu
description: SchemeSetu — personalised scholarship and welfare scheme discovery platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:memory -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
